query:
MATCH p = ACYCLIC (seed:player {id: $seed})-[:follow]->{1,3}(:player)
RETURN transform(nodes(p), n -> n.id) AS node_ids;
notes: Generated from the public prompt and bundled query skill references only. ACYCLIC excludes repeated nodes; ordinary RETURN retains parallel-edge path multiplicity, and transform preserves node order. No database execution performed.
